Decision.summary: Move the ledger database from MySQL to Postgres for better JSON and partitioning support
Roll back the Postgres migration; stay on MySQL 8 until at least Q3 2027 after cutover latency regressions
Use session tokens for internal service authentication
Adopt OAuth2 with short-lived JWTs for all service-to-service auth
Retry failed payments with exponential backoff, max 5 attempts
Require idempotency keys on all payment API writes
Use Kafka for the notification pipeline
Move the notification queue from Kafka to SQS to cut ops overhead
Keep fraud rules in-house instead of buying a vendor engine
Run settlement batch nightly at 02:00 UTC
Apply per-merchant rate limits at the API gateway
Deprecate webhook v1 payloads by end of 2026
